title: AKS vs Container Apps vs App Service
description: Compare Azure's three main compute platforms - AKS, Container Apps, and App Service - to choose the right one for your workload.

data.text: Azure offers multiple ways to run applications. Choosing the right platform depends on your application type, team expertise, and operational requirements.

data.title: AKS vs Container Apps vs App Service

cards.title: App Service
cards.description: Managed platform for web apps, APIs, and mobile backends.

cards.title: Container Apps
cards.description: Serverless container platform with Kubernetes underneath.

cards.title: AKS
cards.description: Managed Kubernetes cluster with full API access.
cons: Cluster always has a base cost

rows: Best developer experience for web apps
Simple APIs deploy quickly to either

data.title: Migration Path
data.text: You are not locked in. You can migrate from App Service to Container Apps (containerize the app), and from Container Apps to AKS (export Kubernetes manifests) as your needs grow.

data.caption: Choosing the right Azure compute platform

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: App Service: simplest for web apps without containers
Container Apps: serverless containers with Dapr
AKS: full Kubernetes for complex workloads
Choose based on workload type, not just familiarity
data.takeaway: Match the platform to your workload, not the other way around.
